description: Maandelijks afgeschafte treinen per operator / type relatie is a dataset listed in Infrabel open data portal, an open data portal of a railway infrastructure manager, published or maintained by Infrabel. Maandelijkse aantal en percentage afgeschafte treinen per operator / type relatie. Een trein kan worden afgeschaft over het geheel van zijn reisweg of over een deel daarvan. Deze dataset vervangt de dataset " Afgeschafte treinen per maand vanaf 2020 ". Coverage: Belgium. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Traffic beheer. Its keywords are Stiptheid, Afgeschafte treinen. The portal shows 2026-03-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open licentie CC0 - Universeel (https://infrabel.opendatasoft.com/pages/license/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-infrabel-open-data-portal.
